claims.evidence: Photos show yellow and blue cylinders but no readable 12.5kg marking; partial text on the yellow body is not legible.
Expiry or last test date stamped on the cylinder is not shown in any photo.
Still photos cannot demonstrate absence of gas leakage; requires a leak or pressure test.
Valve is visible in Photos 1 and 2, but the report does not establish that it is new; chipped paint on the blue collar is noted.

risks.risk: Cylinder may be empty or contain less gas than assumed; actual fill weight unknown.
risks.proof: Photo or video of the cylinder on a weighing scale showing the weight display.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an empty cylinder with no gas.

risks.risk: Expiry or last test date may be missing or expired, making it unsafe or illegal to refill.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stamped test or expiry date on the collar or body.

risks.risk: Valve and seals may be worn, damaged, or leaking even if they look intact.
risks.proof: Close-up video of the valve being opened and closed, plus a leak-test clip such as soapy water or a pressure gauge.
risks.if_unproven: Price as valve not working or requiring replacement.

risks.risk: The yellow and blue cylinders may be separate items rather than one listing.
risks.proof: Photo showing both cylinders together in a single frame with the seller or a single price tag.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a single cylinder only.

risks.risk: Hidden dents, corrosion, or wall thinning not visible in the supplied photos.
risks.proof: 360-degree video or close-up photos of the entire cylinder body, especially the base and seams.
risks.if_unproven: Price as damaged or unsafe for use.

proof_requests: Close-up of any weight marking such as 12.5kg on the cylinder body.
Close-up of the stamped test or expiry date.
Video of the valve operating and a leak test.
Photo showing both cylinders together to confirm if they are one listing.
Full 360-degree view of the cylinder body for hidden damage.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as gas cylinders, so a worst-case price is possible despite unverified claims and hidden risks.
